channel.title: Enid Public Record — Latest Stories and Updates
channel.description: Independent, source-based reporting and public-record research about Enid, Oklahoma.

item.title: Updated: Enid Hotel Tax — Election Result & Accountability Record
item.description: Unofficial Aug. 25 results show Enid voters approved the hotel-tax proposition 3,197 to 2,697 (54.24% to 45.76%), with 23 of 23 election-day precincts reporting. The EPR deep dive now tracks certification, implementation, actual collections and spending decisions.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 8: 133 Years Later
item.description: Part 8 of Enid's Water Story: water from Kaw Lake finally arrives in Enid. See what the city built — the intake, roughly 70-mile pipeline, treatment plant, groundwater blend, financing, costs and what comes next.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 7: Why Kaw? Could Enid Have Built Its Own Lake Instead?
item.description: Part 7 of Enid's Water Story: why Enid chose Kaw Lake over proposed reservoirs near Hennessey, Lahoma and Sheridan, and how cost, drought, permitting and water rights changed the comparison. Updated 2026-08-21.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 6: The Wells Weren't Empty — So Why More?
item.description: Part 6 of Enid's Water Story: why Enid pursued a second major water source even though groundwater remained viable, what the 2042 model actually meant, and how Kaw was designed to diversify rather than replace the wells. Updated 2026-08-21.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 5: The Road Not Taken
item.description: Part 5 of Enid's Water Story: Enid's 38,000 acre-feet of Canton Reservoir storage, the $750,000 agreement with Oklahoma City in 1990, why Enid never used Canton, and the turn toward Kaw Lake. Updated 2026-08-21.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 4: Enid Goes Looking for Water
item.description: Part 4 of Enid's Water Story: how Enid pushed its groundwater system beyond the city limits through distant wellfields, pipelines, leases, condemnation and court fights. Updated 2026-08-21.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 3: What's Under the Water Works?
item.description: Part 3 of Enid's Water Story: Enid's early reservoir, the 1911 pumping plant, underground collection galleries, a giant brick well, and the unresolved frog-pond question. Updated 2026-08-21.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 2: The 26-Foot Well
item.description: Part 2 of Enid's Water Story: the 1900 bond vote, the reported 26-foot-diameter well, and the early waterworks Enid built for growth and fire protection. Updated 2026-08-21.

item.title: Enid's Water Story — Part 1: Before There Was Enid, There Was Water
item.description: Enid's Water Story, Part 1 of 8: Before There Was Enid, There Was Water. Updated 2026-08-21.
